roleRequirements.nextAction: Lead with hands-on implementation outcomes, not only documentation practice.

roleRequirements.label: Guide customer planning, configuration, migration, and structured onboarding
roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare one client-facing implementation example with role and outcome boundaries.

roleRequirements.label: Identify deployment risk and guide technical and behavioral change
roleRequirements.nextAction: Verify one source-backed adoption or migration example before strengthening copy.

roleRequirements.nextAction: Keep the method concrete and bounded rather than presenting a finished product.

roleRequirements.label: Familiarity with Python, SQL, analytics, and data integration patterns
roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare an honest current fluency statement and recent AI-evaluation work.

roleRequirements.label: Five to eight years in product operations, project management, or technical program management
roleRequirements.nextAction: Map the experience chronology without claiming a continuous Product Operations title.

roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare one example distinguishing recommendation authority from collective launch decisions.

roleRequirements.nextAction: Verify the strongest accurate team and sprint example before strengthening public copy.

roleRequirements.label: Quantify revenue, retention, efficiency, and risk to support prioritization
roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare bounded metrics with contribution language and source notes.

nodes.title: CodePath Senior Program Manager, Claude Corps

roleRequirements.label: Three or more years running complex multi-stakeholder projects or programs
roleRequirements.nextAction: Use one end-to-end example with dependencies and recovery.

roleRequirements.label: United States work authorization without employer visa support
roleRequirements.nextAction: Jamie answers privately in the application; do not encode the answer publicly.

roleRequirements.label: Maintain a single accurate program plan across internal and external workstreams
roleRequirements.nextAction: Show how source-backed status and decision records prevent a person bottleneck.

roleRequirements.label: Manage partner commitments, dependencies, blockers, and executive reporting
roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare a factual dependency-recovery example without exposing private correspondence.

roleRequirements.label: Use AI tools as part of a repeatable, accountable operating workflow
roleRequirements.nextAction: Define value in time saved, errors caught, or decisions clarified without invented metrics.

roleRequirements.label: Read program data and dashboards well enough to identify risk
roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare one bounded analytics-to-action example.

roleRequirements.label: Meet the posted education and experience minimum
roleRequirements.nextAction: Confirm the application maps education and experience to one posted pathway.

roleRequirements.label: Coordinate concurrent projects and surface risk before public launch
roleRequirements.nextAction: Keep the first-screen operating result concise.

roleRequirements.label: Build handbooks, runbooks, onboarding guides, and decision records people use
roleRequirements.nextAction: Preserve a concrete onboarding example in the proof map.

roleRequirements.label: Work across product, design, engineering, legal, security, communications, and contracts
roleRequirements.nextAction: Use interview examples without implying every function participated in every project.

roleRequirements.label: Navigate structured hiring, budgets, contracts, or public procurement
roleRequirements.nextAction: Verify bounded public evidence before strengthening this signal.

roleRequirements.label: Report team health and operational metrics and improve systems through retrospectives
roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare one source-backed metric and retrospective example for interview.

roleRequirements.label: Two or more years in Product Operations, Product Strategy, Business Operations, or a similar technology role
roleRequirements.nextAction: Map equivalent work without inventing a formal SaaS Product Operations title.

roleRequirements.label: Improve the flow of customer insight and product data from discovery through launch and iteration
roleRequirements.nextAction: Prepare one accurate feedback-to-change example.

roleRequirements.label: Build dashboards, operating metrics, and experimentation frameworks
roleRequirements.nextAction: Recover source-backed analytics examples; do not imply formal experimentation ownership yet.

roleRequirements.label: Align Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success around launch readiness and adoption
roleRequirements.nextAction: Distinguish adjacent stakeholder work from direct Sales and Customer Success ownership.

roleRequirements.label: Use AI tools and automation to improve workflows and decisions
roleRequirements.nextAction: Show bounded workflow value and human review rather than claiming production AI ownership.

roleRequirements.label: Understand complex physical-world and public-process workflows
roleRequirements.nextAction: Connect built-environment experience to product judgment without implying permitting software expertise.
